_comment: Build metadata for the WoW Classic Era target. Game rules the add-on itself needs live in Target.ClassicEra.lua. See docs/DEVELOPER.md (Targets).
title: WoW Classic Era 1.15.9

require._comment: Coverage the validator enforces. Switch each on when its data exists (docs/DEVELOPER.md).

questie._comment: QuestieDB inputs for this target (pinned commit in tools/upstream.json). npcFlags: the NPC flag values of this data flavor (vanilla numbering: src/corrections/enum/expansions.lua; checked against Dungar Longdrink 11 and Innkeeper Farley 135).
questie._allDangerousMobs: true: Npcs.lua also keeps every hostile elite, rare elite and rare that has spawns (map pins, rare alerts), not only the mobs quests involve.
questie._spiritHealers: true: import-questie writes Database/Questie/SpiritHealers.lua, every Spirit Healer spawn (the Classic client has no graveyard table).

clientTables._flights: true: import-client writes Database/Flights.lua (flight graph) from TaxiNodes and TaxiPath.
clientTables._comment: The 1.15 client tables are shared with Season of Discovery and seasonal realms and carry their spells too, with no marker; all of those have ids of 400000 or more. Spells from 400000 are left out of trainer and pet data and listed in docs/generated/ClassicEra/client-excluded-spells.csv. Talent trees are not filtered.
clientTables._excludeSpellIds: 22570 Mangle: the 1.15.9 tables list it as a level-6 druid Feral spell, but Classic Era druids cannot learn it (Mangle is not in the game until TBC; the id below 400000 escapes the seasonal rule).

evidence: Questie bundle/v12.3.1+v1.0.9 release.json: flavor classic at interfaces 11508 and 11509, checked 2026-10-29

xpPerLevel._comment: XP needed to go from level N to N+1, for N = 1..59 (route audit XP model only; the add-on does not use it).
